study.question: Does retaining task-specific history content while adding a separately projected signed valid-rank summary recover useful position information, beyond matched content capacity, and improve on g0 and the current task-conditioning incumbent at measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: replacing compact task content by signed rank in R9 reduced macro AUC from 0.8291974850684669 to 0.8281968308222298 (private) and from 0.8290504142234297 to 0.8281377389242202 (mean). Private-minus-mean also shrank from +0.0001470708450372 for content to +0.0000590918980096 for moments. The private replacement hurt all four task AUCs, especially fav: click -0.0000804713, cart -0.0008122042, fav -0.0027509589, buy -0.0003589826; Logloss deltas respectively +0.0000582450, -0.0000081009, +0.0000042743, +0.0000180978. These observations oppose replacement utility, not all uses of moments. A centered signed sum can cancel order-independent components of the score-weighted values and cannot in general recover their content sum; a separate learned map may let content C remain available while exposing order as C+P(M). The shared g0 moment path is retained, so redundancy remains plausible. R8 compact private/mean (0.8293139662/0.8288793482) and wider capacity private/mean (0.8292372986/0.8286690649) gave no simple gain from added width. R7 stop cells differ by less than 0.000075 macro AUC and a same-seed replay equals R6 exactly, so neither gradient isolation nor repeated support is established. This is a prospective rescue/control experiment, not a claim of a new established mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest local content source. Keep shared token representation, compact scorers, content summary and FP32 accumulation. Append only a shared zero-initialized 112x112 map of an additional task-weighted summary, without enlarging tower inputs.

These failed replacement trajectories substitute signed rank for task content. Here content remains explicitly available and rank enters through a separate zero-initialized map. This additional map requires a matched content-capacity control.

Inherit the shared relation/count/linear-moment token stack. New summary uses action-aware task relevance at the direct readout, rather than the shared scorer and relation-token projection. This may be redundant; g0 remains the stronger imported source comparator.

DIN uses target-aware unnormalized weighted history pooling and preserves activation intensity. The inherited model extends those ingredients to four tasks and shared relation/moment tokens. The proposed change preserves content while adding signed valid-rank evidence, with a matched content map. No exact DIN reproduction or priority claim.

nearest_work.source_ref: paper:infnet; https://arxiv.org/html/2508.11565v1; primary sections 3.1-3.2, lines 103-169 read via web; registry has link-only detail and fallback unirank-benchmark-v2
nearest_work.difference: INFNet uses categorical, sequence and task tokens, task/shared proxies, cross-type attention and within-type gated refinement. Here the shared backbone is retained and only the direct task history summary is augmented. This is not an INFNet reproduction; its local effectiveness and novelty relative to the wider literature remain unverified.

inherited_components: Read-only released feature embedding and input filtering API; six advertisement fields and historical action; target action forcibly zero; visible-history masking before embedding/scoring
g0 shared target relevance, global plus four chronological bins, seven relation groups, explicit counts and signed linear moments, shared JointBlock and four towers
R8/R9 width-64 shared task scorer trunk with four distinct nonlinear heads and zero output initialization; private/mean routing before FP32 task pooling; source initialization and RNG forks
Default four-task BCE; no label-dependent forward feature, history task-mask selection, timestamp reconstruction, extra data pass or host change
study.proposed_difference: In each routing arm let C_t=sum_i s_ti v_i, and E_t=sum_i s_ti b_i v_i. For linear b is centered unit-RMS rank among visible events; for copy b=1 on visible events. Return C_t+P(E_t), where P is a shared 112x112 bias-free zero-initialized map. Keep all shared g0 summaries unchanged. Both reductions and P execute in every cell with FP32 accumulation/projection/addition before restoring value dtype. Append P after inherited initialization within torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]). The full 2x2 crosses extra basis linear/copy with private/mean routing. The copy map adds learned content capacity but no new order information. All cells start at the corresponding content-source function; they are scratch runs, not warm starts. Initial zero task scorers make the projection gradient initially zero, so numerical diagnostics must examine a later/nonzero state.
predictions: Primary contrast: content_plus_linear_private exceeds content_plus_copy_private on equal-weight four-task validation macro AUC, then retains a positive paired-seed difference. A single-seed difference is provisional. A candidate that exceeds its capacity control but not the incumbent supports at most local utility, not a new best model.

Compatibility success additionally requires repeat-confirmed improvement over imported g0 0.8283262734957326, imported g3 0.8123335254548857 and incumbent g3-r0006-linear_private 0.8294419075559136. Report all task AUC/Logloss deltas against DIN, both imported sources, content parent and incumbent; selection has no undeclared task veto.

Positive factorial interaction [(linear_private-copy_private)-(linear_mean-copy_mean)] would support extra utility from task-aligned position summaries. Positive linear contrasts in both routing arms but no interaction support an order channel without task-specific attribution. Private advantage alone repeats a routing observation, not a new moment result.

Branch diagnostics in eval with fixed scorer/value contents: content sum is permutation invariant, signed rank responds to visible-event order, reversal flips only the isolated moment branch, padding offsets do not alter visible rank, and empty/single-event signed rank is zero. The full shared model is already order-sensitive; do not attribute full-model reversal changes solely to the new branch.

Exploratory history-bin diagnostics use existing empty/1-16/17-64/>64 boundaries, include samples/positives/negatives per task, and mark sparse slices. Extra branch has no direct effect on empty histories, but trained shared parameters may change their predictions. No causal slice claim from these observational groups.
falsifiers: Linear-private fails to improve on copy-private across paired repetitions, or a comparable gain occurs from the content-capacity map alone: added order-specific utility is unsupported.

Retained-content linear augmentation remains below its source or incumbent despite finite learning and correct gradients: preserve the failed rescue result; do not declare signed moments globally refuted.

Positive linear-private advantage disappears with mean routing or has no repeat-consistent interaction: task-specific/order synergy is not established. Negative interaction opposes that synergy even if macro quality improves.

Rank/projection never receives usable gradients after task scores become nonzero, padding or current-action perturbations change predictions, inherited state/RNG checks fail, or actual costs breach the host trial cap: implementation is invalid/unfinished, not scientific counterevidence.
Added training/inference/memory cost has no justified quality gain versus the compact content parent and incumbent. Matched exposure is a mechanism comparison, not an equal-compute efficiency result.
alternative_explanations: All available results are one training seed selected on the same validation split; same-seed replay is reproducibility, not independent confirmation
The added map changes optimization and may learn slowly after zero task-score outputs; representation capacity and learned utility differ
Private/mean controls change loss sharing as well as which summary each tower receives; they do not uniquely identify gradient interference

R9 harm could arise from cancellation removing useful intensity, poor signed-summary conditioning, one-pass optimization, or redundancy with g0 shared moments; its negative result does not identify which explanation is correct.
A zero-initialized map may make this augmentation conservative but slow in a one-pass recipe. No training extension is permitted to rescue it within this comparison.
Model-only diagnostics were not requested in past receipts; successful training/scoring does not prove masking or gradient mechanisms. New host preflight is necessary.
Auxiliary labels concern user/category/brand events within 24h, not advertisement-specific conversions; offline action visibility and whole-window vocabularies limit production interpretation.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Read the source card, cached benchmark description and original INFNet primary method sections. Task-aware token exchange is relevant context, but no local effectiveness evidence justifies replacing the successful shared backbone here.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No new mechanism adopted from this card. The implemented content-preserving map is a follow-up to R9 local replacement harm.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: INFNet performs layer-wise task/proxy cross-type attention and gated within-type refinement; this change augments an inherited direct history summary.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: No transferable effectiveness or originality claim; a future matched task-token replacement would be needed to test that design locally.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Primary archived Eq.3 discussion confirms unnormalized target-aware pooling/intensity as nearest inherited background; this does not prove the explanation for R9 harm.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Preserve inherited content/intensity summary while independently adding signed rank; no new DIN code adopted.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Shared multi-field relation/moment tokens and task-conditioned augmentation extend the inherited local adaptation; no exact reproduction or novelty claim.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If signed augmentation does not beat content-capacity controls, DIN intensity rationale alone does not rescue the mechanism.
